folds.heading: ## Content reconciliation B268
folds.body:
All735original lines reviewed, including A1-D1–7/D8, A1-F6–14, every74row import entry, named exceptions, both boundary-loop inventories, the full registry sketch, eight adapter moves/H1–24, schema/import stages, A1-C1/C2, RD1–6, M2.1–6, six monolith seams, seven W6 joins, six later angles and five ranked changes. The ledger really contains25simulation.js and49simulation_effects.js import rows. That table arithmetic validates the document's count, not current source dependency completeness or behavior.

The opening and closing October18 qualifications already resolve the plan's main reuse boundary: current domain_registry/AR1–16 and later M1–M3 evidence own implemented seams; this October14 design is not a second live specification. Its proposed runtime registry, hook contract, global save_format/save_versions, migration chain, old worktree order and first-milestone references remain unselected history. Reuse the existing owner, with AD51 allowing the first known useful consumer and a second world validating/revising it. The [October24 milestone retirement](../../../../USER_VISION.md#first-milestone-and-scope-check-2026-10-24), AD41 primary checkout and current [UI targets](../../../../UI_RULES.md) qualify the old one-realm/one-prestige, worktree-per-change and1366/1600desktop wording. Old soldier pause and named lane reservations need actual current authority if material, not this snapshot.

A1-F8/F9/F10 preserve an important distinction: no literal destination ID does not mean no world coupling. Imported callbacks, enriched inputs, effect-time relocation/custody logic, group/prefix guards and the outer scheduler each carry semantics. Moving a list of fact providers alone cannot establish an adapter extraction. Keep current call/overwrite/input order and actual short-circuit and transaction boundaries during a behavior-preserving move. The discovered next-boundary versus due-check/controller asymmetry is not automatically a confirmed defect, and preserving it for parity is not a new permanent design rule. Tightening it would be a separate selected behavioral change with its actual failure case.

A1-D2's registry/load permutation test concerns duplicate registration and declared ordering, not arbitrary commutation of causal state changes or alphabetic provider merges. Read/write conflict diagnostics without values can still reveal sealed provider/key existence; keep author diagnostics private or use the established opaque IDs, without publishing a key census to the player. A registry's presence is not enrollment, custody, actor knowledge or rights. An immediately evaluated preview is not a stale commit authorization; each actual boundary revalidates its own continuing support under AR7/ABR11.

The six RD proposals retain useful separate meanings. A person view needs actual body/controller/native identity and a consistent input frame; relationship sources keep direction, ranges and knowledge; capabilities keep competence/source/fuel/expression; requirement evaluators are not bodily conditions; a common action list is not one executor; a battle read shape is not universal combat grammar. Do not erase legacy fractional requirements in a boolean wrapper, turn missing into known zero, double-apply two views of one effect, or silently persist a projection. The proposed `readPerson`, `readMeans` and other APIs are sketches, not current exported functions. The full [A4 audit](../a4/AUDIT.md#content-reconciliation-b266) separately preserves source-qualified relationship findings.

A1-F11/F12 already show5–11 are owner/reader admission states, not a linear5→11migration. Expansion, simulation, native envelope, retirement, pack and definition/rules revisions are separate version domains. The plan's A1-C1 compatibility choice and proposed global runner cannot override the later explicit old-save deferral. For a selected structural extraction preserve its chosen supported behavior; a new feature need not restore every old format or build a shadow migration runner first. Original bytes, exact-content suspension, generic parking, retention and ordinary persistence still use their actual owners and compatibility decisions. A metadata version cannot itself prove that a frozen commitment is readable or settle it twice.

M2's lexical RNG/import/panel counts are dated measurements with explicit unknowns; they do not establish gameplay determinism, every panel's kit coverage or current acceptance ceilings. Exact adapter classification is more informative than a filename heuristic, but no current rescan or ratchet rebasing occurred. Line removal and zero-world-import goals are review signals subordinate to actual mechanism/consumer benefit, not reasons to minify or block feature work. Differential fixtures can protect a selected extraction; their ordered causes, pending jobs and external native effects must match applicable inputs. This does not mandate a second production executor or a universal new suite. No registry, migration, source extraction, test, build, branch integration or runtime behavior was changed or newly verified.

folds.heading: ### Consolidation plan detail uptake B268
folds.body:
The complete [A1 consolidation plan](gm/dispatch/core-foundations-2026-10-14/a1/PLAN.md#content-reconciliation-b268), including its74import rows, both scheduler inventories and RD1–6/M2/M11 proposals, has been reviewed. Its own October18 boundary already routes to the implemented domain_registry and later modular evidence; it does not require another registry, global save format or re-extraction. Preserve source-level order and native/effect/support joins for a selected structural move; an apparent next-boundary/due-filter asymmetry remains a dated observation until its behavior is investigated, not a universal rule or current defect claim.

The proposed read shapes correctly distinguish fractional requirements from bodily conditions, internal truth from observer UI, source/fuel from competence and read unification from executor/store merger. Keep those distinctions when an actual consumer needs a seam (AD51), without creating all six APIs in advance. Save schemas5–11 in the snapshot are not a linear migration chain. Current compatibility decisions, AD36/AD41/AD42 and current viewport owners supersede old worktree, migration, human-review and milestone gates. Lexical counts,74table rows and a list of historical tests do not supply current source or runtime proof. Detailed scope and original IDs remain in the plan.
